        raise ValueError("selection_date must be a completed date in YYYY-MM-DD")

def _summarize_batches(batches):
    complete = [item for item in batches if item["status"] == "completed"
        and item["summary"].get("average_return") is not None]
    summary = {"total_batches": len(batches), "complete_batches": len(complete),
        "incomplete_batches": sum(item["status"] == "incomplete" and item["summary"].get("selected", 0) > 0 for item in batches),
        "unavailable_batches": sum(item["status"] == "unavailable" for item in batches),
        "empty_batches": sum(item["status"] != "unavailable" and item["summary"].get("selected") == 0 for item in batches),
        "evaluated_start_date": min((item["selection_date"] for item in complete), default=None),
        "evaluated_end_date": max((item["selection_date"] for item in complete), default=None)}
    for field in ("average_return", "market_return", "industry_return", "excess_market", "excess_industry"):
        # Every headline refers to exactly the same complete cohorts. Missing
        # comparators stay missing rather than silently changing the sample.
        values = [item["summary"][field] for item in complete if item["summary"].get(field) is not None]
        summary[field] = _mean_complete(values, len(complete))
    comparable = [item for item in complete if item["summary"].get("excess_market") is not None]
    industry_comparable = [item for item in complete if item["summary"].get("excess_industry") is not None]

    return summary


def _range_summary(result):
    batches = result["batches"]
    result["summary"] = _summarize_batches(batches)
    result["awaiting_observation"] = any(item.get("awaiting_observation") for item in batches)
    result["status"] = ("completed" if batches and all(item["status"] == "completed" for item in batches) else
        "unavailable" if not batches or all(item["status"] == "unavailable" for item in batches) else "incomplete")
    if result.get("sampling") != "all_market_days_v1":
        return
    groups = []
    for offset in range(result["horizon"]):
        stats = _summarize_batches(batches[offset::result["horizon"]])
        groups.append({"offset": offset, **{key: stats[key] for key in (
            "total_batches", "complete_batches", "average_return", "excess_market")}})
    values = [group["average_return"] for group in groups if group["average_return"] is not None]
    result["offset_stability"] = {"groups": groups, "min_average_return": min(values, default=None),
        "max_average_return": max(values, default=None)}
    periods = []
    first, last = pd.Timestamp(result["start_date"]), pd.Timestamp(result["end_date"])
    for year in range(first.year, last.year + 1):
        periods.append((str(year), max(first, pd.Timestamp(year, 1, 1)), min(last, pd.Timestamp(year, 12, 31))))
    periods.append(("近1年", max(first, last - pd.DateOffset(years=1)), last))
    result["period_summaries"] = [{"label": label, "start_date": start.date().isoformat(),

    result.update(batch_id="history_" + uuid.uuid4().hex, parent_batch_id=source["batch_id"],
        source_operation_id=operation_id, observation_cutoff=_cutoff().isoformat(),
        created_at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat())
    result["calculation"]["continued_observation"] = (
        f"沿用原选股日已冻结的股票名单，本次仅补充读取截至{result['observation_cutoff']}的后续行情，不重新选股。")
    result["limitations"] = list(source.get("selection_limitations", source.get("limitations", [])))
    # A continuation produces a new artifact. The saved list and its selection
    # evidence are copied before any data read; no model is called here.
    _persist(result)
    try:

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Historical continuation incomplete: %s", type(exc).__name__)
        result["status"] = "incomplete"
